content.en: The **International Finance Corporation (IFC)** is the largest global development institution focused on the private sector in emerging markets. It provides **investment, advisory, and asset management services** to encourage private enterprise. Unlike the IBRD, which lends to governments, the IFC works directly with private companies to foster job creation and poverty reduction.
